10.steps:
1. Go to the DHCP Server page. configuration X0 DHCP Server, In the domain name section, try to a value of 63 allowed character (number, letter, hypens, dot). Hit Update after input.
  2. PC connects to X0, do ipconfig /release&ipconfig /renew, check the packet.
  3. In the domain name section, try to input a domain that include upper cases or all in upper cases, e.g. SONICWALL.COM, SonicWall.com, click OK.
 4.PC  do ipconfig /release&ipconfig /renew, check the packet.
 5. In the domain name section, try to input a multiple level domain like eng.sonicwall.com, 123.456.test.com, click OK.
 6. PC  do ipconfig /release&ipconfig /renew, check the packet.
 7. In the domain name section, try to input a domain that include unsupported characters including: Underscores, Spaces, Dashes, Symbols, Special Characters, Apostrophes, Ampersand, Commas
10.title: Valid Domain Value
10.result:
1. Step 1 - Step 6. The box should allow the value to be updated in the GUI. check the packet,  DHCP Offer/ACK contains option 15 and its value is match with GUI. 
 2. GUI will pop up error 'Invalid Domain Name.'
